name: memory_crystallizer
description: Episodic Experience Memory & Troubleshooting Retrieval Engine. Stores and indexes past problem solutions into SQLite FTS5 for sub-millisecond JIT contextual recall without token bloat.

category.description: Category of experience (e.g. tool_foundry, kernel_fix, syntax_error, network).

problem.description: Clear description of the encountered issue or goal.

solution.description: Empirically verified solution steps or code fix.

keywords.description: Indexing keywords for FTS5 full-text matching.

query.description: Search query string for FTS5 recall.

chat_file.description: Optional path to JSONL chat file to harvest.
